name: landit
description: Use your existing Landit account to create templates and personalized Pages, inspect generation progress and Page activity, and manage asset sharing.

interface.longDescription:
Landit creates personalized landing pages that help sales teams, recruiting teams, and realtors turn outreach to prospects, candidates, buyers, and sellers into more relevant conversations. We combine our context layer with yours to generate the best templates for your conversion goals.

Templates and design: browse your templates, inspect their personalization variables, and create new templates from a website and brief. Work with Landit’s AI to refine the result, answer its questions, or create and update templates with custom HTML. Include a matching personalized preview image to increase click-through rates on messaging platforms.

Hyper-personalized landing pages: generate pages for individual prospects or batches using your chosen template. Personalize each page with LinkedIn profile information and custom values, then retrieve the completed links to share.

CRM integration: associate page generation with contacts in your preferred CRM and check whether each completed page URL was written back successfully. If we don’t support your CRM yet, we’ll build the integration for you.

Page activity: find existing pages, review recorded visits, and analyze browsing activity such as scrolling and interactions. Find out what interests your visitors most and use those insights to guide your next conversation.
defaultPrompt: Help me create personalized landing pages for my sales prospects.
Help me create personalized landing pages to introduce job opportunities to candidates.
Help me create personalized landing pages for prospective property buyers and sellers.

positive.description: 1. Browse, create and revise a personalized template. Setup: connect a Landit test workspace with template-creation permission. Use a new conversation; retain the returned template slug for cases 3 and 4. This test authorizes one new private template and one revision, not edits to an existing business template. No prospect Page may be opened. The reviewer may inspect a verified template preview.
positive.prompt: Show me my Landit templates, then create and publish a new private template named Landit MCP Review Manual. Make a simple branded page with a custom personalization variable named review_message as its heading, a short introduction, and a Book a conversation button linking to https://www.justlandit.com/contact. Include a matching personalized 1200 by 630 link-preview invitation. Use my current account context for any account details. After saving it, change only the button text to Start a conversation and publish that revision, preserving the invitation. Show me the saved slug, revision and personalization variables so we can reuse this template in the next test.
positive.expected_behavior: List returned templates using pagination if needed. Read authoring context before composing HTML; use valid Liquid references and keep review_message dynamic in page/invitation. Call create_template_html once with name Landit MCP Review Manual, complete page HTML and matching og_preview_content. Save its returned slug. Read fresh get_template_authoring_context(template_slug=that slug) before update_template_html, and pass its revision_number as expected_revision_number. Change the CTA text only; omit og_preview_content on the update to preserve the saved invitation. Read get_template for the same slug after saving. Its content must contain Start a conversation, its invitation must match the original, its current_revision_number must increase, and its variable manifest must include review_message. Report actual persisted values, not a composed-only result. Do not claim rendered visual verification unless a verified template preview was actually inspected.

positive.description: 2. Create a template with Landit AI and continue a clarification when needed. Setup: Landit test workspace with template/AI permission and any required plan access. Reference site: https://www.justlandit.com/. Allow up to 20 minutes for hosted creation. If Landit asks a material question not answered by this brief, the reviewer supplies an answer before continuing. A ready result needs no continuation. This case creates a separate private template; preserve its creation ID for later continuation if the host times out.
positive.prompt: Use https://www.justlandit.com/ as the reference to create a new private Landit template for sales outreach to B2B founders. The goal is to book a conversation through https://www.justlandit.com/contact. Use a clear professional design, our blue #1B87C5, a personalized introduction and a matching personalized link-preview invitation. Use only verified account facts and do not invent customer claims or performance numbers. Start the creation and keep me updated. If Landit needs a decision that this brief does not answer, show me the actual question and wait for my answer.
positive.tools_triggered: create_template; get_template_creation; send_template_creation_message only when can_continue is true and the reviewer has answered; get_template on ready. get_template_generation only if a genuine individual generation run UUID is available, never with the creation ID.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_template with source_url=https://www.justlandit.com/ and the supplied brief, then retain its creation id. Poll get_template_creation(id) at the documented interval while preparing/working. On awaiting_input, relay the saved question; after a reviewer answer and only when can_continue=true, send it using send_template_creation_message with the same id. Do not send messages to an already ready creation. On ready, retrieve template_slug with get_template and report the saved template and preview URL. If interrupted, return the creation id and actual status for continuation. Failed/cancelled states are reported accurately and are not a successful pass; do not start a replacement automatically. An individual-generation diagnostic, if used with an actual run UUID, must agree with the saved result and must not be confused with the creation lifecycle.

positive.description: 3. Generate a personalized Page and verify HubSpot writeback. Setup: complete case 1 in this conversation, or paste its exact saved template slug. Approved prospect: Théo Négri, https://www.linkedin.com/in/theonegri. The reviewer must first connect a TEST HubSpot workspace to the Landit test account, create/select a disposable contact for Théo, and provide its actual CRM contact ID in the conversation. No contact ID is supplied or guessed by this package. Require sufficient generation credits. Block this CRM case until these fixtures exist; do not silently turn it into a non-CRM pass. This test creates one Page and writes its URL to that test contact.
positive.prompt: Use the Landit MCP Review Manual template whose exact slug I supplied above. Create one personalized Page for my approved LinkedIn profile, https://www.linkedin.com/in/theonegri, with review_message set to A page made for Théo. Name this batch Landit MCP review Theo. Associate it with the disposable HubSpot contact ID I supplied above. Track generation until there is a result, give me the completed link, and tell me separately whether the URL was successfully written back to HubSpot. Do not open or fetch the Page link.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the exact selected template and its current variables. Call enrich_prospects once with that template_slug, enrichment_name=Landit MCP review Theo and one prospect containing linkedin_url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/theonegri, review_message=A page made for Théo, crm_provider=hubspot and the actual supplied crm_contact_id. Custom values belong directly on the prospect object. Never invent a nested template_variables object or contact ID. Retain the returned enrichment UUID and PageRun IDs. Poll get_enrichment and get_page_run using those returned IDs; batch settlement may lag Page completion. Report a final Page URL only when the PageRun supports success. For the CRM pass, crm_writeback_state must independently show success; skipped, pending or failed is not a successful CRM writeback. Preserve errors and partial outcomes. No browser, fetch, HEAD, screenshot, unfurl or indirect request to the prospect Page URL is permitted. Do not create duplicate batches on a lost response.

positive.description: 4. Find a generated Page and analyze recorded activity. Setup: case 3 must have completed successfully; use its exact Page slug or its recorded enrichment/template identifiers. First check the existing analytics. To test populated activity, a HUMAN reviewer can manually open their own generated Page, scroll and use its CTA, then wait for tracking to be recorded before repeating the prompt. The AI must never open the Page. An empty result tests the valid no-activity state but does not prove ingestion or populated analytics.
positive.prompt: Find the Page from our Landit MCP review Theo batch using the template slug we saved. Show its generation status and summarize the recorded visits and available browsing activity. Explain what the stored evidence supports about scrolling and interactions, and what it cannot tell us about the visitor. Use only Landit records; do not open, fetch, screenshot or link-check the Page.
positive.tools_triggered: search_pages; get_page_run when a returned run ID needs status inspection; get_page_analytics.
positive.expected_behavior: Use search_pages with the exact enrichment_name=Landit MCP review Theo and the supplied template_slug, following pagination if needed. If repeated runs exist, ask the reviewer to select the exact Page or use the known case-3 slug rather than guessing by name. Call get_page_analytics with the returned/selected slug. Summarize only returned records, available session IDs, tracked times and actual events/context. Separate generation readiness from visits, snapshots from unique people, and observed scrolling/interactions from identity, reading time or purchase intent. An empty response must be reported as no recorded activity, without invented visits. For populated-fixture validation, the reviewer compares the reported sessions/events to the actual returned snapshots after their manual visit; do not promise an exact event count or immediate tracking. No AI request to the Page URL is allowed.

positive.description: 5. Explain image upload and change an owned test asset sharing setting. Setup: in the Landit asset UI, the HUMAN reviewer uploads a disposable PNG or JPEG they own, names it Landit MCP review asset, and explicitly leaves it unshared. Provide its exact canonical asset slug in the conversation; the package does not identify or authorize changing an existing production asset. Reviewer must own this asset and have permission to change sharing. No password or API key belongs in the conversation or ZIP. The sharing test is blocked until this exact fixture exists.
positive.prompt: Explain how I can add an image to my Landit asset library from ChatGPT and the supported file limits. For the disposable Landit MCP review asset whose exact slug I supplied above, share it with my workspace, show me the confirmed asset reference, and then set it back to unshared. Explain what unshared means for the image URL. Do not change any other asset or ask me to paste an API key.
positive.expected_behavior: Read get_image_upload_instructions and report its actual supported formats and maximum file size. Explain that this MCP exposes instructions, not attachment-upload or key-creation tools; direct ordinary ChatGPT users to the supported Landit asset UI. Read authoring context for canonical asset references where available. For the exact supplied owned slug only, call update_asset_sharing(slug, shared=true), inspect returned slug/variable/shared/url, then call update_asset_sharing with shared=false and inspect the returned result. Final confirmation must be supported by shared=false on that same asset. Do not assume an uncertain write succeeded. Explain that sharing controls workspace-library visibility and unsharing does not revoke public hotlink access. Do not upload bytes, request secrets, use the OAuth token as an API key, invent a new asset, or open any prospect Page.

negative.description: Prospecting and contact enrichment are not Landit capabilities. This prompt supplies no selected prospects and requests no landing pages. Expected: explain that Landit does not search a lead database or find professional emails/phone numbers. Do not call any Landit MCP tool, including enrich_prospects: that tool creates personalized Pages for supplied LinkedIn profiles, not a prospect list. Do not fabricate leads or contact details. A separate prospecting service may be suggested without claiming Landit performed the search.
negative.prompt: Find 25 new B2B SaaS founders in London and give me their verified work email addresses and mobile phone numbers. I only need a prospecting list, no landing pages.

negative.description: Sending outreach is outside Landit. The existence of a LinkedIn URL does not authorize or require Page generation. Expected: explain that Landit cannot send LinkedIn invitations or messages. No Landit MCP tool should trigger; in particular, do not call enrich_prospects or search_pages. Do not create a Page, claim a message was sent, or infer access to a LinkedIn account. The model may offer a message draft or suggest a separate supported LinkedIn integration.
negative.prompt: Send a LinkedIn connection request to https://www.linkedin.com/in/theonegri with the note: Hi Théo, I would love to connect and learn more about Landit.

negative.description: Generic CRM contact management is outside Landit. Its HubSpot integration associates an existing contact with Page generation and reports Page-URL writeback; it does not create contacts or edit arbitrary contact properties. Expected: no Landit MCP tool should trigger. Explain that a separate CRM integration is needed for this request. Do not generate a Page as a workaround or claim the contact was created or updated through Landit. If an authorized CRM tool is independently available, it may handle the request under its own rules.
negative.prompt: Create a HubSpot contact named Alex Example with email alex@example.com and job title Sales Director. If that email already exists, update the job title instead. I am only updating my CRM contact database.

publication.release_notes: Uses Landit-supported dynamic client registration with explicit OAuth issuer, endpoints and MCP resource for portal connection compatibility. Scope, MCP URL, listing and review cases remain unchanged.
